title: Surreal Fractured Dream
description: A surreal painting of a woman's face split by a glowing lightning bolt, featuring a large central blue eye on her forehead and two smaller blue eyes. Her hair consists of orange leaves and turquoise vines with white and orange flowers, set against a dark starry background within a cracked purple and turquoise rock formation with dripping orange liquid.
